description: Returns chain config (networkKey, accountKey, chainID). Use the returned chain value in all subsequent transfer/sign/broadcast tools.

chain.description: Chain name or alias (matching is case-insensitive). Use the returned `chain` value for all subsequent tools on that network.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

name: dex_chain_config
